RC1_events.signs: Currents positive into named component port. Negative MP_CLEAR D charge delivers charge into RC1; C1/R1/native receiver gates take the balancing charge.
RC1_events.interpretation: Actual native total D/G/S/B currents including displacement; closed incidence budget identifies branch exchange, not a unique intrinsic Cgd/channel/diode decomposition. Only standard native X005 MM1/MM0 used.

HD_output_backflow.interpretation: Complete four-port incidence of HD; negative NAND gate total current returns charge, positive X005 D total absorbs it. No intrinsic fractions inferred.
